body:
Source: the ADLC principle-fidelity audit (delta.md, PR #486). This ticket remediates one of the eight root-cause "seams" that audit found — cases where the toolkit trusts the model at the boundary between a built gate and the deployed system.

SEAM 7 (medium, some high). Individual gates have vacuous or dodgeable edges: (a) spec-lint passes on a spec with ZERO acceptance criteria, or criteria under a heading its scanner doesn't recognize — the F1 gate rejecting under-specification passes a spec that specifies nothing; (b) the suppression-marker check is a case-sensitive per-line substring scan over a closed list, dodgeable by case/whitespace/unicode/concatenation (the diff PARSER is hardened, but the marker LIST is not); (c) hand-enumerated registries (run-tests plugin segments, the completed:true triple copy) have no completeness guard.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR
1. spec-lint: fail closed (exit 2) on zero recognized acceptance criteria — treat "no criteria found" as the strongest under-specification signal, not the absence of one.
2. suppression-marker scan: normalize (case, whitespace, unicode) before matching; where a linter-directive grammar exists, parse it rather than substring-scan. Follow the diff-parser hardening already present next door.
3. registries: add bijectivity/completeness tests (the docs registry already does this — ALL_PACKAGES must equal the packages/ listing; copy that pattern) for the run-tests plugin segments.

## Acceptance Criteria

- spec-lint exits 2 on a spec with zero recognized acceptance criteria. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/zero-criteria.test.mjs`
- The suppression scan catches a marker that varies by case/whitespace/unicode. verify: `node --test packages/rails-guard/test/suppressions-normalize.test.mjs`
- A run-tests segment registry completeness test fails when a plugin dir is unlisted. verify: `node --test scripts/test/run-tests-completeness.test.mjs`
- Existing spec-lint and suppression tests still pass. verify: `node --test packages/spec-lint/test/*.test.mjs packages/rails-guard/test/suppressions.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: Close vacuous-pass edges: spec-lint zero-criteria, suppression-marker normalization, registry completeness
